rows.label: Scottie Scheffler
rows.hook: dominated the sport as world number one and won multiple green jackets at Augusta

rows.label: Rory McIlroy
rows.hook: won four major titles and is famed for a smooth swing and long drives

rows.label: Adam Scott
rows.hook: won the green jacket at Augusta with a long-handled putter in a playoff

rows.label: Nelly Korda
rows.hook: became one of the top women's golfers and won an Olympic gold medal

rows.label: Bryson DeChambeau
rows.hook: is a physics-minded bomber known for oversized-length drives and one-length irons

rows.label: Arnold Palmer
rows.hook: is the king of golf whose fans formed an army, and who has an iced tea and lemonade drink named for him

rows.label: Jack Nicklaus
rows.hook: is the Golden Bear who won a record eighteen major championships

rows.label: Phil Mickelson
rows.hook: is a lefty famous for flop shots who became the oldest ever major winner at the PGA Championship

rows.label: Gary Player
rows.hook: is the Black Knight, one of golf's three greats, who won all four majors and dressed in black

rows.label: Greg Norman
rows.hook: is the Great White Shark, a long-time world number one famous for Sunday collapses at Augusta

rows.label: Geoff Ogilvy
rows.hook: won the US Open at Winged Foot in a tough-conditions finish

rows.label: Collin Morikawa
rows.hook: won the Open Championship and the PGA Championship before turning thirty on his first tries at each

rows.label: Brooks Koepka
rows.hook: won back-to-back US Opens and several PGA Championships, then joined the LIV breakaway tour

rows.label: Tommy Fleetwood
rows.hook: is a fan favourite known for runner-up finishes in majors and a long ponytail-era Ryder Cup heroics

rows.label: Justin Rose
rows.hook: won Olympic gold when golf returned to the Games and a US Open at Merion

rows.label: Jordan Spieth
rows.hook: won the Masters and US Open in one season as a young star, then added an Open Championship

rows.label: Bobby Jones
rows.hook: won the original grand slam of golf's four majors, then retired and co-founded the Masters

rows.label: Francis Ouimet
rows.hook: was a young amateur and former caddie who stunned the golf world by beating British stars at the US Open

rows.label: Ian Poulter
rows.hook: is a flamboyant dresser famed for fiery Ryder Cup performances

rows.label: Lee Trevino
rows.hook: is the Merry Mex, a wisecracking six-time major winner who was once struck by lightning

rows.label: Justin Thomas
rows.hook: won two PGA Championships and a FedEx Cup title, and is a close friend of Jordan Spieth

rows.label: Patrick Reed
rows.hook: won the Masters green jacket and earned a Captain America nickname for Ryder Cup play
